item.title: The ‘Mother of All Deals’ Is Here: India and EU Seal Historic Free Trade Agreement
item.description: India—EU Free Trade Agreement has been announced by India and the EU; a free trade agreement that aims to reshape India’s global trade relations with EU. The post The ‘Mother of All Deals’ Is Here: India and EU Seal Historic Free Trade Agreement appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Public Convenience over Hawking Rights: Provisional COVs do not allow permanent vending or encroachments, rules Del HC
item.description: “There ought to be free space for movement of the public. Beautification and development of the area is also required, so that the passengers and tourists can enjoy a comfortable experience while visiting a bus stand or the nearby railway station.” The post Public Convenience over Hawking Rights: Provisional COVs do not allow permanent vending or encroachments, rules Del HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: India Has 879 Fast Track Courts Operational, 1800 Recommended: Law Ministry
item.description: Law Minister Arjun Ram Meghwal updates Parliament on Fast Track Courts: 879 functional across 22 States/UTs, handling pending cases from 2015—2020. The post India Has 879 Fast Track Courts Operational, 1800 Recommended: Law Ministry appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Right to Menstrual Health part of Right to Life: SC issues directions on Free Sanitary Pads, Menstrual Hygiene Management corners in schools
item.description: The Supreme Court also directed that such Menstrual Hygiene Management (MHM) corners must be established in every school, and they should be equipped with spare innerwear, spare uniforms, disposable bags, and other necessary materials to address menstruation related exigencies. The post Right to Menstrual Health part of Right to Life: SC issues directions on Free Sanitary Pads, Menstrual Hygiene Management corners in schools appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi HC restrains ex-employee posting videos defaming ‘Physics Wallah’; orders takedown of disparaging content
item.description: “Disparagement through misleading and/or abusive statements, constitutes an unlawful interference in other party’s commercial goodwill and is actionable in law.” The post Delhi HC restrains ex-employee posting videos defaming ‘Physics Wallah’; orders takedown of disparaging content appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Call for Participation | The Xth CIPR Essay Writing Competition
item.description: The Centre for Intellectual Property Rights, NUALS Kochi invites submissions for the Xth CIPR Essay Writing Competition on “The Public Domain in the Age of Technology”. The post Call for Participation | The Xth CIPR Essay Writing Competition appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Tenants’ right to timely redevelopment prevails over developer’s commercial interests: Bombay High Court
item.description: “The society and its members cannot be made to wait endlessly for the developer to take necessary steps in the redevelopment process.” The post Tenants’ right to timely redevelopment prevails over developer’s commercial interests: Bombay High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Inside the Newly launched Digital Notary Portal: How Notarial Services Are Going Paperless
item.description: Law Minister Arjun Ram Meghwal updates Parliament on launching Notary Portal to digitally modernize legal services under the Notaries Act, 1952 and Notary Rules, 1956. The post Inside the Newly launched Digital Notary Portal: How Notarial Services Are Going Paperless appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Marriage in law, not in substance: Delhi HC waives one-year bar under Section 14 HMA for couple who never cohabited
item.description: “Insisting upon continuation of a marriage which exists only in law, and not in substance, would amount to compelling the parties to endure a relationship devoid of any matrimonial foundation, thereby causing avoidable hardship rather than advancing the object of the statute.” The post Marriage in law, not in substance: Delhi HC waives one-year bar under Section 14 HMA for couple who never cohabited appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Law Ministry outlines initiatives for establishing Legal Aid Centres in tribal and remote belts
item.description: Law Minister Arjun Ram Meghwal informed the Parliament about the expansion of legal aid and alternate dispute resolution systems, improved legal aid accessibility in Odisha, and ongoing efforts to support SC/ST communities. The post Law Ministry outlines initiatives for establishing Legal Aid Centres in tribal and remote belts appeared first on SCC Times.
